exposure: Children born by elective caesarean section
Children born by acute caesarean section
cohort: 1921 children born by vaginal delivery, 283 by elective caesarean section, and 227 by acute caesarean section
finding: Children born by elective caesarean section had a higher incidence rate ratio for hospitalizations due to infection compared to children born by vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with hospitalization due to infectious disease during early childhood.
